01 / What we do

A competitive price means little if the supplier can't deliver.

Finding Indian manufacturers is relatively easy. Knowing which one can meet your specifications, quality requirements, quantity and delivery expectations is harder.

We help you make a better-informed sourcing decision.

FOCUS / 01

02 / Initial sourcing focus

Industrial fasteners.
Sourced to your specifications.

We initially focus on sourcing industrial fasteners and related metal components from India.

Whether you're comparing current suppliers, exploring Indian manufacturing or looking for additional capacity, we can help investigate suitable production options.

Products

  • Hex bolts and screws
  • Nuts and washers
  • Studs and threaded rods
  • Stainless-steel fasteners
  • Carbon and alloy-steel fasteners
  • Selected custom fasteners

Technical requirements

  • SS304 / A2 and SS316 / A4
  • Property classes 8.8, 10.9 and 12.9
  • DIN / ISO specifications
  • Zinc-plated and hot-dip galvanized finishes
  • Material certificates and conformity documentation
  • Drawings, dimensions and packaging requirements

Send us your specification, quantity and destination. We'll assess whether suitable Indian manufacturing options can be identified.

03 / Our process

From one requirement to a clearer sourcing decision.

A structured way to compare sourcing options before committing to an order.

  1. 01

    Share Your
    Requirement

    Tell us what you need: product specification, material, quantity, required standards and delivery destination.

  2. 02

    Identify Suitable
    Manufacturers

    We investigate Indian manufacturers whose available capabilities align with the product and commercial requirements.

  3. 03

    Compare Sourcing
    Options

    Where suitable quotations are available, we organize pricing, MOQ, lead time, technical details and available supplier documentation for comparison.

  4. 04

    Decide the
    Next Step

    Review the findings and decide whether to proceed with samples, additional checks, supplier discussions or a trial order.

You remain in control of the purchasing decision. We're here to make the sourcing process more informed and organized.

Trust & transparency

Clear information.
Better sourcing decisions.

Source Bridge is an independent India-based sourcing service, not a manufacturer.

We focus on understanding buyer requirements, investigating suitable suppliers and presenting available technical and commercial information clearly.

Supplier capabilities, documentation and inspection findings should be supported by evidence—not assumptions.

We can coordinate further verification, samples and third-party quality inspections when a project requires them.

Buyer questions

Before you begin.

Are you a manufacturer?

No. Source Bridge helps overseas buyers identify, compare and evaluate potential Indian manufacturers.

Is the initial sourcing benchmark free?

We offer an initial benchmark for suitable enquiries at no sourcing fee. Any additional paid services are discussed before work begins.

Can you guarantee product quality?

No sourcing process can eliminate every risk. We help coordinate supplier assessments, samples, documentation and independent inspections as appropriate to the requirement.
